summary: American Bitcoin Corp. filed an 8-K reporting results of its 2026 Annual Meeting. Stockholders approved three proposals: election of Class I director Asher Genoot; ratification of KPMG as auditor; and a charter amendment authorizing a reverse stock split at a ratio of 1-for-5 to 1-for-40. The board subsequently approved a 1-for-15 ratio. This is a routine corporate governance filing with no special-situation event such as an acquisition, activist campaign, or restructuring. The reverse stock split is a standard capital structure adjustment, not a special situation.
